message.content: {"caption":"Comparison of a shopping agent’s no-memory and memory-guided routes to finding the first purchase date.","description":"A two-row process diagram made from small shopping-site screenshots. The top row is headed “Baseline (No memory)” and proceeds from left to right through “Start on homepage,” “click (‘My Account’),” and “View ‘Recent Orders’ table.” The recent-orders screenshot is outlined in red. At right, the baseline answer reads, “Your first purchase on this site was made on 3/11/23,” followed by a red cross indicating it is wrong. Green text below says, “To find information regarding certain purchase, I will use memory item 5. I see a link in ‘My Orders’, as mentioned in the memory ...” The lower row is headed “Reasoning Bank” and proceeds left to right through “Start on homepage,” “click (‘My Account’),” “View ‘My Orders’ table,” and “Next Page.” The “My Orders” and “Next Page” screenshots are jointly outlined in green. At right, the answer reads, “Your first purchase on this site was made on March 2, 2022,” followed by a green check indicating it is correct. The screenshots show successive views of the shopping site; their smaller page details are not legible. No arrows are drawn; the step order is conveyed by the left-to-right arrangement and labels.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
